records.text: Additionally, sales were impacted by overall enrollment declines in higher education.

records.text: Product and other sales are impacted by comparable store sales (as noted in the chart below), new store openings and store closings, as well as the impact from the COVID-19 pandemic.

records.title: 10-Q Q321 20210130
records.text: Recently, the impact of fewer students on campus due to COVID-19 has significantly impacted our on-campus buyback programs which supplies Wholesale’s used textbook inventory for future selling periods.

records.title: 10-Q Q321 20210130
records.text: While many big athletic conferences resumed their sport activities, fan attendance at the games was either eliminated or severely restricted, which further impacted the company’s high-margin general merchandise business.

records.text: Our operating loss was $(64.7) million during the 13 weeks ended January 30, 2021, compared to an operating loss of $(3.0) million during the 13 weeks ended January 25, 2020.
